title: BEST Shulker Farm Minecraft Tutorial - EASY! - 1,750/HR!
description:
In This Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the new Super Easy and compact Shulker Farm that is extremely fast and connected to a supercharger in Minecraft!

📝Important Details About This Farm :
📚This is a new module that uses a new box method within a new connector to a supercharger
📚This farm is easy to build and can produce +1750 Shulker Shells Per Hour! 
📚The Farm will work after armor stand patches on 1.20.2 but if you are lower than 1.20.2 it's fine too even above 1.20.2 is fine as well!
📚You can build this anywhere you want to except ( Savanna, Nether, badlands, and dessert )
📚This farm is based on simple mechanics and now in the new version due to an update the speed of production rate is about 20 to 30% higher

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
